title: The Impact Sex-Related Differences of Infrarenal Aortic Neck Morphology on Endovascular Aneurysm Repair for Similar-Sized Aortic Aneurysms
content:
Objectives: the purpose of this study was to determine whether gender-related proximal neck anatomic variables influence the applicability and outcomes of aortic endografting in women with abdominal aortic aneurysms of similar size
Methods: this retrospective study includes all consecutive patients who underwent elective EVAR for abdominal aortic aneurysms (AAA) with a maximum diameter ranging from 5.0 to 6.0 cm between January 2019 and December 2023.
